note: One row per reference FLOW state of each adopted app (R-241): the harvested states plus the states found by driving the adopted app. Every state has a disposition — bound (a live verifier assertion proves it over daemon truth), refused (the app refuses it by name; a test proves the refusal), named_gap (visible on the surface as `shown_as`), or open (known and not yet handled — the census counts these down to zero). A proof names a file and the EXACT text of an assertion or test in it, so renaming one breaks the link. No tenant data: labels are the reference's own UI words.
